The quiet notebook

This introduction offers a short route into the notebook and explains why each observation has a place in the record.

The main column sits in the centre of the viewport, while these ordinary paragraphs begin at the column edge. The wide outer space belongs to the page layout.

Read the observations

Each entry describes a small change in the garden and gives enough context to compare it with the next visit. The lines need room at both narrow and wide viewports.

Return to the details

A second look often brings a different detail into view. Keep the earlier note nearby and record what changed without losing the context of the first visit.
